Definition: of uncertain affinity; a stud, i.e. spike:--nail.
BiblicalUsage: Helos is a nail, the spike itself, and it appears once, in Thomas's condition for believing. In John 20:25 he says except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print, I will not believe.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Thomas asked for the one proof that could not be faked: the marks where the nails went in; the risen Lord still carries them, and that is why Thomas can believe.
